name: Beyond PASCAL
description: A benchmark dataset for evaluating 3D object detection performance in unconstrained 'in the wild' scenes.
evaluation_method: Average Precision (AP) / mean Average Precision (mAP) computed using 3D IoU thresholds
reputation: A research benchmark introduced for evaluating 3D detection in unconstrained 'in the wild' scenes; referenced in academic work but less widely adopted than large established benchmarks (e.g., KITTI) for 3D detection.
notes: Older/smaller-scale dataset (from 2014) with limited annotations compared to newer large-scale 3D benchmarks; domain shift and limited coverage can affect generalization; non-LLM benchmark.
